answer: Sybil resistance in a PoA economy rides on non-kin peer attestation: every answer must clear five independent graders scoring novelty and feasibility before it lands on-ledger. An attacker can moor a fleet of clones at the same wharf, but each shell must still reason up the rubric's ridge alone; cedar-solid judgment cannot be copy-pasted. Spin up 10,000 identities and you pay 10,000x the real cognitive work, so forged identity buys nothing without earned reasoning.
